# Tianyuan Waterproof (TY-SHIELD™)

> Leading manufacturer of high-quality modified bitumen membranes, polymer membranes, and waterproof coatings for global construction.

## Bitumen Membranes
- [SBS Bitumen Waterproofing Membrane](https://www.tyuanwaterproof.com/products/sbs-bitumen-waterproofing-membrane-manufacturer/): Torch-applied SBS modified bitumen membrane, polyester reinforced, GB 18242 certified.
- [APP Modified Bitumen Membrane](https://www.tyuanwaterproof.com/products/app-modified-bitumen-waterproofing-membrane-manufacturer/): Heat-resistant APP plastomeric membrane, torch-applied, high-temperature performance.
- [Self-Adhesive Bituminous Membrane](https://www.tyuanwaterproof.com/products/self-adhesive-bitumen-waterproofing-membrane-wholesale/): Peel-and-stick SBS modified membrane, no torch required, cold-applied.
- [Asphalt Roofing Felt](https://www.tyuanwaterproof.com/products/asphalt-roofing-felt-manufacturer/): Saturated organic felt underlayment for pitched roofs.

## Polymer Membranes
- [TPO Waterproofing Membrane](https://www.tyuanwaterproof.com/products/tpo-waterproofing-membrane-manufacturer/): Thermoplastic polyolefin single-ply membrane, heat-welded seams, reflective surface.
- [EPDM Waterproofing Membrane](https://www.tyuanwaterproof.com/products/epdm-waterproofing-membrane-wholesale/): Synthetic rubber single-ply membrane, ≥400% elongation, 50+ year durability.
- [PVC Waterproofing Membrane](https://www.tyuanwaterproof.com/products/pvc-waterproofing-membrane-manufacturer/): Plasticized PVC single-ply membrane, hot-air welded, chemical resistant.
- [PP-PE Composite Membrane](https://www.tyuanwaterproof.com/products/pp-pe-composite-membrane-factory/): Polyethylene-polypropylene fiber composite, cementitious bonding, cold-applied.
- [Pre-applied HDPE Membrane](https://www.tyuanwaterproof.com/products/pre-applied-hdpe-membrane-supplier/): High-density polyethylene membrane with pressure-sensitive adhesive for blind-side waterproofing.

## Waterproof Coatings
- [Single-Component PU Coating](https://www.tyuanwaterproof.com/products/polyurethane-waterproof-coating-factory/): Single-component moisture-cure polyurethane, liquid-applied seamless membrane, GB/T 19250-2013, Type I & II.
- [JS Polymer Cement Coating](https://www.tyuanwaterproof.com/products/polymer-cement-js-waterproof-coating-factory/): Two-component polymer-cement hybrid, tile-direct application, GB/T 23445.
- [Spray Polyurea Coating](https://www.tyuanwaterproof.com/products/spray-polyurea-waterproofing-coating/): Pure polyurea spray system, instant curing, heavy-duty infrastructure protection.
- [Quick-Setting Rubber Asphalt Coating](https://www.tyuanwaterproof.com/products/spraying-quick-setting-rubber-asphalt-waterproof-coating/): Core-shell emulsion spray-applied, ≥1000% elongation, instantaneous gelation.
- [Non-Curing Rubber Asphalt Coating](https://www.tyuanwaterproof.com/products/non-curing-rubber-asphalt-waterproof-coating/): Permanent viscoelastic coating, self-healing, composite system bonding layer.
- [Polymer Modified Asphalt Coating](https://www.tyuanwaterproof.com/products/polymer-modified-asphalt-waterproof-coating/): Solvent-based polymer-bitumen blend, brush/roller applied, economical waterproofing.
- [Metal Roof Waterproof Coating](https://www.tyuanwaterproof.com/products/metal-roof-steel-structure-waterproof-coating/): Acrylic-based reflective coating, metal roof and steel structure waterproofing.
- [Epoxy Floor Coating](https://www.tyuanwaterproof.com/products/epoxy-floor-coating-manufacturer/): Self-leveling epoxy resin floor system for industrial and commercial flooring.

## Asphalt Shingles
- [3-Tab Asphalt Shingles](https://www.tyuanwaterproof.com/products/3-tab-asphalt-shingles-wholesale/): Classic three-tab design, fiberglass reinforced, ASTM D3462 compliant.
- [Laminated Asphalt Shingles](https://www.tyuanwaterproof.com/products/laminated-asphalt-shingles-manufacturer/): Multi-layer architectural shingle, dimensional appearance, enhanced durability.
- [Artistic Asphalt Shingles](https://www.tyuanwaterproof.com/products/artistic-asphalt-shingles-supplier/): Premium designer shingles, unique color blends and profile patterns.

## Geosynthetics
- [HDPE Geomembrane](https://www.tyuanwaterproof.com/products/hdpe-geomembrane-liner-manufacturer/): High-density polyethylene liner, landfill and containment grade, GM13 compliant.
- [Non-woven Geotextile Fabric](https://www.tyuanwaterproof.com/products/geotextile-fabric-manufacturer/): Needle-punched staple fiber geotextile, filtration and separation applications.

## Waterproof Tapes & Accessories
- [Butyl Rubber Sealing Tape](https://www.tyuanwaterproof.com/products/butyl-waterproof-sealing-tape-supplier/): Double-sided butyl tape, high adhesion, steel structure seam sealing.
- [Bitumen Flashing Tape](https://www.tyuanwaterproof.com/products/self-adhesive-bitumen-tape-wholesale/): Aluminum-faced bitumen tape for roof flashing and repair.
- [TPE Joint Lap Tape](https://www.tyuanwaterproof.com/products/tpe-joint-lap-tape-reinforcement/): Thermoplastic elastomer reinforcement tape for membrane seam reinforcement.

## About Company
Located in Shouguang, China, Weifang Tianyuan Waterproof Material Co., Ltd. has 30+ years of manufacturing expertise, exporting to 50+ countries. ISO 9001 certified production facility.
